newsitem.title: USA: Midwest Express cites increased capacity.
newsitem.headline: Midwest Express cites increased capacity.

text.p: Midwest Express Holdings Inc, reporting weaker February and year-to-date load factors, blamed recent capacity additions.
"As we expected, load factor decreased due to the capacity we added last May and September," Chairman Timothy Hoeksema said in a statement.

"However, because of the strong industry pricing environment, we're continuing to capture premium revenue yield that will result in revenues in line with our expectations," he said. He did not elaborate.

The carrier bought on line an additional aircraft in May and another in September, and added service to additional markets. In September it added new nonstop service between Kansas City and Boston, and last May it increased the frequency of flights to several existing markets.
